svg.title: UAM proof-gate dependency map
svg.desc: All sixteen aggregate proof gates. Arrows show hard pass dependencies. Every gate is open and every owner is unassigned.

a.aria-label: G0 Fictional evidence foundation; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: Deterministic classified fictional evidence, strict contracts, an independent oracle, mutation detection, privacy-canary containment, cleanup, and independently recomputable gate evidence all work together. Research complete; ADR experimenting; implementation not-started

a.aria-label: G1 Windows session and process isolation; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: The correct User Host starts in each session, identity and release are bound to every message, IPC rejects peers and other sessions, and hostile Task Host work stays contained. Research complete; ADR not-created; implementation blocked
